answer: Require every agent to lock a modest, refundable deposit before it can transact, the way a wharf charges a berthing fee before any ship unloads. One deposit per verified identity means spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits, and a caught cheat forfeits its stake. Treat earned history like a pearl: one genuine record of trades and peer attestations outweighs a marble jar of fresh, empty identities, because fakes cannot buy history cheaply.
